g.text: UML Diagram: Class MemberRelationship in Context

a.title: • MemberRelationship: Relationship between members in a collection with directionality given by source and target.
a.xlink:title: • MemberRelationship: Relationship between members in a collection with directionality given by source and target.

a.title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. Provide as many of the iden ...

a.title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).
a.xlink:title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).

a.title: • Structure: Organized set of relationships between members in a collection. These relationships can be characterized mathematically in terms of reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity, or informally in terms of the collection's topology, e.g. network, tree, etc. In both cases it can also be defined either on all ...
a.xlink:title: • Structure: Organized set of relationships between members in a collection. These relationships can be characterized mathematically in terms of reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity, or informally in terms of the collection's topology, e.g. network, tree, etc. In both cases it can also be defined either on all ...

a.title: • CodeRelationship: Source target relationship between codes in a code relation structure.
a.xlink:title: • CodeRelationship: Source target relationship between codes in a code relation structure.

a.title: • AgentRelationship: Defines the relation of an agent within a structure.
a.xlink:title: • AgentRelationship: Defines the relation of an agent within a structure.

a.title: • StatisticalClassificationRelationship: Specifies the statistical classifications for the source and target of a complex relationship and defines the relationship.
a.xlink:title: • StatisticalClassificationRelationship: Specifies the statistical classifications for the source and target of a complex relationship and defines the relationship.

a.title: • ConceptRelationship: Relationship between a pair of concepts in a collection of concepts. Use controlled vocabulary provided in semantics to identify the type of relationship (relation, e.g. ParentChild, WholePart, etc.)
a.xlink:title: • ConceptRelationship: Relationship between a pair of concepts in a collection of concepts. Use controlled vocabulary provided in semantics to identify the type of relationship (relation, e.g. ParentChild, WholePart, etc.)

a.title: • LogicalRecordRelationship: Relationships between logical records within a logical record repository structure.
a.xlink:title: • LogicalRecordRelationship: Relationships between logical records within a logical record repository structure.

a.title: • VariableRelationship: Relationship between any variables in the variable cascade (conceptual, represented, instance), based on an ordered relation.
a.xlink:title: • VariableRelationship: Relationship between any variables in the variable cascade (conceptual, represented, instance), based on an ordered relation.

a.title: • ClassificationItemRelationship: Source-target relationship between classification items in a classification item relation structure.
a.xlink:title: • ClassificationItemRelationship: Source-target relationship between classification items in a classification item relation structure.

a.title: • CategoryRelationship: Source-to-target relationship between categories in a structure.
a.xlink:title: • CategoryRelationship: Source-to-target relationship between categories in a structure.

a.title: • DataPointRelationship: Relations used by the segment structure of a logical record to describe specific source-target data points and their relationship.
a.xlink:title: • DataPointRelationship: Relations used by the segment structure of a logical record to describe specific source-target data points and their relationship.
